versions.changelog:
geekbi-ozon-product-search-skill v0.1.0

- Initial release of the skill for querying and analyzing real Ozon product data via 极鲸云.
- Supports SKU/SPU search, product details, price, sales, reviews, stock, sellers, fulfillment, 7/28-day metrics, and history.
- Defaults to the Russia site and RUB if not specified; supports other markets by first fetching supported site list.
- Adheres strictly to 极鲸云 data, excluding image search, profit estimates, and seller backend operations.
- Provides up to 200 product results and discloses data sources and sample scopes in reports.
- Displays missing values as '-', and only provides links if returned by the data response.
